title: To revise the boundaries of certain John H. Chafee Coastal Barrier Resources System units in New Jersey.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the House passed version is repeated here.)

(Sec. 1)This bill modifies certain boundaries of the John H. Chafee Coastal Barrier Resources System Units located in Middlesex and Monmouth Counties, New Jersey.

summary.headline: A 2016 law changes the boundaries of certain Coastal Barrier Resources System units in Middlesex and Monmouth Counties, New Jersey.
summary.what_it_does: The law revises the mapped edges of some units in the John H. Chafee Coastal Barrier Resources System located in Middlesex and Monmouth Counties, New Jersey. The official summary does not say which specific areas were added or removed. It also does not describe the federal rules that would change for any property as a result.

who_it_affects.group: Owners of land inside the affected Coastal Barrier Resources System units in Middlesex and Monmouth Counties, New Jersey
who_it_affects.how: Their property may fall inside or outside the revised unit boundaries, but the summary does not say which properties changed.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2016, and the summary does not give a separate effective date.
